{{Otheruses|Coruscant Museum}}
{{Quote|Though the Emperor has been forced to eliminate funding for the museum, due to costs incurred in snuffing out the damaging rebellion against his rule, he has given his verbal support for the museum to continue to preserve the heritage of his subjects.|[[Pollux Hax/Legends|Pollux Hax]]|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
[[File:FreedonNaddGalacticMuseum-TFNU1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Galactic Museum ''c.'' [[3998 BBY]].]]
The '''Galactic Museum''', also known as the '''Imperial Museum''',<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref><ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] and a vast repository of data that was established on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] over twelve thousand years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A branch of it was located in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] near the [[Dewback Inn]], and it had archives on the [[Frozen Moon of Improcco]].

==Overview==
This museum contained various artifacts and relics from thousands of different cultures; both still living and those that were long lost. The body's membership consisted of teams of [[Sentientologist|anthropologists]], [[Librarian/Legends|librarians]], [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], [[Historian/Legends|historians]] and [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] all of whom were dedicated for the quest for knowledge. Their efforts allowed for a constant addition to the museum's archives which meant that expansion was an ongoing process as new halls were added in order to store new artifacts as well as lore. The Galactic Museum was a large complex structure that was divided into numerous halls with artifacts devoted to a single individual culture or instead contain either physical or historical relics of close civilizations which held only a small number of surviving artifacts.<ref name="TJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

The different exhibit wings took days to explore and contained information on the Annals of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the History of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Masterpieces of Expression, Flora and Fauna, as well as Planetary Cultures. The collective number of artifacts numbered in the billions though only one percent was ever on display. Instead, the millions of other artifacts were stored within the archive building within the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo District]]. Another location for the storage of such artifacts was in underground vaults of immense size that were located on the [[Frozen Moon of Improcco]]. A security system were used to take pictures of anyone entering within the residence of the museum in order to deter and capture any [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] that sought to steal treasured artifacts.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

One of the more infamous halls within the Galactic Museum was the [[Sith Hall]]. This wing of the complex was located forty levels below the top most structures and individuals seeking it had to navigate a twisting series of corridors. It contained various artifacts recovered from the fall of the Sith Empire, including [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] books, [[Sith talisman/Legends|amulets]] and [[Sith talisman/Legends|talismans]]. After being created, it was known that these [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] tainted artifacts sent whispers of their influence through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. However, the Jedi Order overlooked this fact as they believed that the combined presence of so many Force users simply drowned out the temptations of the artifacts. Unknown to many, a number of such artifacts had, however, come to the museum through illegal means which meant no administrator or [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had managed to inspect them. Many individuals that sought to learn of the Sith such as their knowledge, beliefs, civilization and magic often came to this branch of the Galactic Museum.<ref name="TJC" />

One of the positions within the museum included the title of [[Master Curator]].<ref name="HoloNet News">{{InsiderCite|66|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:3:22}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Mara_Jade_Galactic_Museum.jpg|thumb|left|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the Galactic Museum.]]
Originally, the Galactic Museum was established more than twelve thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Its purpose was to contain information and artifacts from almost every known [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] with the intention of preserving worthy relics and thus make the museum the premier repository of knowledge in known space.<ref name="CCW" /> Following the destruction of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], many artifacts relating to the ancient Sith came to the museum and led to the creation of the Sith Hall which was devoted to finding information about the Sith.<ref name="TJC" /> A sealed wing contained Jedi artifacts, including [[Nejaa Halcyon]]'s [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. There was also some darker, obscure pieces of information that could be found in the Galactic Museum, including the near-extinction of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] (caused by falling debris from the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]). However, much of this information may have simply been Imperial [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Master Curator of the Galactic Museum was [[Asran Headows]].<ref name="HoloNet News" /> After the rise of the Empire, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had the Jedi Order wing of the Galactic Museum closed off and renamed the Annals of the Republic into ''"The New Order: The Glories of the Next Generation"''. Despite the Emperor's purges, only a few artifacts were destroyed during this age.<ref name="CCW" /> 

Also known as '''Emperor Palpatine's private museum''', he kept his personal collection of [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. It was destroyed around the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when the sabotaged [[bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Doriella's Mystress]]'' (rigged with [[detonite/Legends|detonite]]) fell on it. The explosion impacted the lower levels of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]].<ref>''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref><ref name="merger">{{WEGCite|story=The Business Merger|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref><Ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Palpatine was enraged by the destruction of his museum and seized [[RenTrans]]' assets, banished the [[Rendar family]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and threw their younger son [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash]] out of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].<Ref name="sotesb" /><Ref>''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>

The Galactic Museum's new display on [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] was toured by several members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] prior to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|fall of Coruscant]], and provided them with much insight into the Empire, especially the Empire's propaganda machine. The display featured [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of [[Vyn Narcassan]], [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand]] and [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

Upon the [[New Republic/Legends|restoration of the Republic]], the new government ensured that the Galactic Museum was restored to its original state.<ref name="CCW" /> It was later destroyed during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|fall of Coruscant]], however it was rebuilt eventually, detailing a fairly neutral depiction of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Divisions==
*[[Galactic Museum Artifact Recovery Office|Artifact Recovery Office]] - this division of the Museum was in charge of funding expeditions to recover lost relics, artifacts and forgotten pieces of technology. They were involved in paying for an undercover expedition to recover the [[Emperor's Shadow (shuttle)|''Emperor's Shadow'']], a shuttle used by the late Emperor Palpatine and was believed to had possessed an advanced [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking shield]].<ref name="FFCA">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The media related to the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' project mention "Emperor Palpatine's private museum" and Stanton Rendar's "accident" as the cause for the fall of grace of the [[Rendar family]].<ref name="sotesb" /> Dash Rendar's profile in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' mentions the event as happening on the "Imperial Museum", thus conflating the two. Despite the suggested size of the disaster, apparently the Galactic/Imperial Museum was not destroyed.
